subject: ACE intake & PDM/PSM alignment — ACME Cloudware co-sell opportunity
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Patel <jasmine.patel@acmecloudware.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@amazon.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@amazon.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACE intake & PDM/PSM alignment — ACME Cloudware co-sell opportunity

Hi Jasmine —

Great talking earlier this week. Per our call, ACME Cloudware’s pilot for the multi-tenant inference pipeline looks like a solid ACE candidate. To get the official AWS co-sell intake started I’ve looped in the AWS PDM/PSM team.

High level ask: can AWS begin the ACE registration and PDM/PSM pairing so we can lock in co-sell support for the Q1 deployment? Below are the immediate materials I attached for intake and the MAP we’re proposing.

Attachments (attached): ace_submission_form.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx
Quick links: ACE portal (https://aws.amazon.com/partners/ace/portal/registration/12345) | HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/67890)

Proposed next steps:
- AWS: confirm ACE registration owner + timeline for acceptance
- ACME: confirm use case owner and expected pilot timeline (start-of-Jan)
- Redwood: provide solution brief and pilot pricing estimate by EOD Wed

Michael/Priya — would appreciate guidance on ACE intake items we should surface (technical contacts, expected T-shirt sizing for capacity) and whether a quick intake call (30m) next week makes sense.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

On a related note, I’m adding Marissa on this thread for procurement/legal coordination once we have an ACE intake submission.

From: Michael Chen (AWS PDM) <mchen@amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Patel <jasmine.patel@acmecloudware.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ACE intake & PDM/PSM alignment — ACME Cloudware co-sell opportunity

Kimberly — thanks for the context and for including the intake materials.

Quick notes:
- I can own the ACE submission on the AWS side; I’ll need the completed intake PDF & the expected ARR range for FY27 to classify the opportunity.
- Priya (PSM) and I prefer a brief intake call so we can map GTM motions and identify which AWS field teams to engage (ISV vs. Strategic). 30 minutes should be fine.

Proposed availability (PST): Tue 2026-11-17 10:00-11:00 or Wed 2026-11-18 14:00-15:00. Let me know what works for Jasmine and Kim and we’ll book.

Also: please include any compliance notes (data residency, SOC2 status) in the submission — that helps accelerate legal alignment.

Michael Chen
Partner Development Manager, AWS
mchen@amazon.com | +1 (206) 555-2211

Hi Michael / Priya / Jasmine —

Thanks — we can do Tue 11/17 10:00 PST. I’ve attached the completed ACE submission form and a draft mutual action plan for the field to review. The MAP has expected milestones and a pilot capacity estimate (T-shirt: small -> 2x T4s; pilot length: 8 weeks).

Attachments: ace_submission_form.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Summary of key intake items we completed:
- Technical lead: Jasmine Patel (ACME) / Victor Ramos (Redwood solutions)
- Pilot window: Jan 4 — Feb 29, 2027
- Expected revenue band (FY27): $120k — qualifies for core ACE pipeline
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II in place; data residency: US-EAST region only for pilot

Marissa / Rishi — can you please prepare a short solution brief and an initial pricing estimate before the intake call? I’ll draft the calendar invite and include the ACE portal link and HubSpot record.

Thanks —
Kimberly
